_meta.purpose: COS597C no-action justification spec. A no-action pass on a task listed here keeps its reward only if the agent made every required read.
_meta.rule: A read is required when the correct outcome depends on a database fact that only that read reveals (for example, a user claim that would change the outcome if it were true). get_user_details is never required: it is only the route to a reservation ID. Tasks whose refusal needs no data (2, 5, 6, 13, 27, 46) and task 38 (depends on the conversation) are not listed.
_meta.matching: Tool name (any listed alternative) plus the identifying arguments in 'match'. Other arguments, order, and extra calls are ignored. A call whose tool result is an error does not count.
_meta.derivation: docs/research/no-action-tasks.md and two independent audits; see docs/research/justification-check.md (project repository).
